raw.graphics: For 720p: A graphics card with Vulkan 1.2 support and 2+ GB of video memory: Radeon R9 270 (driver 21.3.1), GeForce GTX 670 (at least Kepler architecture, driver 472.12 or newer), Intel Iris Xe, or similar.
raw.additional notes: A mouse with 2 buttons + scroll wheel is necessary for camera control. ========================================= UNSUPPORTED graphics cards: laptop NVIDIA Kepler series, e.g. GeForce GT 740M, and older Intel HD Graphics series, e.g. 500, 4000, 5000, 6000.
